sanskrit:
तमस्त्वज्ञानजं विद्धि मोहनं सर्वदेहिनाम् ।
प्रमादालस्यनिद्राभि स्तन्निबध्नाति भारत ॥ १४-८॥
iast:
tamastvajñānajaṃ viddhi mohanaṃ sarvadehinām
pramādālasyanidrābhi stannibadhnāti bhārata 14-8
translation: But, know thou TAMAS is born of ignorance, deluding all embodied beings, it binds fast, O Bharata, by heedless-ness, indolence and sleep.
